title: Graded or crisp prerequisite knowledge? Auditing thresholding and t-norm path inference in fuzzy knowledge graphs built from learner logs (code, results and run files)
description: Reference implementation, reproduction scripts and result files for the manuscript submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems: fuzzy-graph modularity and the rank-coded cut audit, the calibrated null test (Algorithm 1), generator shortest paths for t-norm path inference, and the pre-deployment audit (Algorithm 2) as a command-line tool, with every analysis in results/, results/v4/, results/v5/ and results/v6/. Release 4.3.0 adds the analyses of the second revision: the Junyi transition construction varied for the community question, the decision floor with ten planted graphs and a bootstrap interval, the weighted SBM with matched initialisations for observed and null fits, a finer power grid, the Claim 1 check counted over 390 runs, and a complete pass over the MOOCCubeX exercise log. Datasets are not redistributed; see data/README.md.
